description: Type of hotel for the booking.
notes: Useful categorical predictor; should be encoded during preprocessing.

description: Target variable: 1 if the booking was canceled and 0 if it was not canceled.
notes: Prediction target; must not be used as an input feature.

description: Number of days between booking creation and arrival date.
notes: Important booking-timing predictor; check for high/extreme values during EDA.

description: Year of arrival.
notes: Date component; useful for period coverage and possible time-based patterns.

description: Month of arrival.
notes: Date component; useful for seasonality analysis and should be encoded carefully.

description: Week number of the arrival date.
notes: Date component; useful for weekly arrival patterns.

description: Day of month of arrival.
notes: Date component; useful for arrival-day pattern checks.

description: Number of weekend nights included in the stay.
notes: Stay-length feature; check zero-night and extreme-stay records.

description: Number of week nights included in the stay.
notes: Stay-length feature; check zero-night and extreme-stay records.

description: Number of adults in the booking.
notes: Guest-count feature; check records with zero total guests.

description: Number of children in the booking.
notes: Guest-count feature; contains a small number of missing values.

description: Number of babies in the booking.
notes: Guest-count feature; check rare or unusual high values during EDA.

description: Meal package booked by the guest.
notes: Categorical predictor; Undefined/SC categories should be reviewed before encoding.

description: Guest country of origin.
notes: Categorical predictor with many unique values and some missing values.

description: Market segment through which the booking was made.
example_values: Direct; Corporate; Online TA; Offline TA/TO; Complementary
notes: Categorical predictor; Undefined values require investigation.

description: Booking distribution channel.
notes: Categorical predictor; Undefined values require investigation.

description: Indicates whether the guest is a repeated guest.
notes: Binary predictor that may indicate guest history.

description: Number of previous bookings canceled by the customer.
notes: Customer-history feature; likely relevant to cancellation behavior.

description: Number of previous bookings not canceled by the customer.
notes: Customer-history feature; likely relevant to repeat guest behavior.

description: Room type originally reserved.
notes: Original room type selected at booking time; should be encoded during preprocessing.

description: Room type assigned to the booking.
notes: Not confirmed leakage, but a possible post-booking operational attribute that requires investigation before modeling.

description: Number of changes made to the booking.
notes: May reflect customer/booking changes before final outcome; timing should be understood before modeling.

description: Type of deposit made for the booking.
notes: Categorical predictor that may be strongly related to cancellation behavior.

description: Travel agency identifier.
notes: Identifier-like categorical field with missing values; missing may mean no agent.

description: Company/entity identifier associated with the booking.
notes: Identifier-like categorical field with many missing values; missing may mean no company association.

description: Number of days the booking stayed on the waiting list.
notes: Operational feature; check skewness and high values during EDA.

description: Type of customer or booking contract.
notes: Categorical predictor describing booking/customer contract type.

description: Average Daily Rate calculated for the booking.
notes: Numerical price-related feature; check negative and extreme values.

description: Number of car parking spaces required by the guest.
notes: Guest request feature; may indicate stronger booking intention.

description: Number of special requests made by the guest.
notes: Guest request feature; may indicate stronger booking intention.

description: Final reservation status.
notes: Confirmed leakage risk because it directly represents the final booking outcome.

description: Date when the final reservation status was last updated.
notes: Confirmed leakage risk because it may be known only after cancellation/check-out status is confirmed.

description: Guest name included in the validated dataset.
example_values: Ernest Barnes; Andrea Baker; Rebecca Parker; Laura Murray; Linda Hines
notes: PII/identifier field; should not be used as a predictive feature.

description: Guest email address included in the validated dataset.
notes: PII/identifier field; should not be used as a predictive feature.

description: Guest phone number included in the validated dataset.
notes: PII/identifier field; should not be used as a predictive feature.

description: Masked credit card value included in the validated dataset.
notes: Masked PII/identifier field; should not be used as a predictive feature.
